messages:
alyssa: FYI — Vendor sent a revised quote this morning. They’re quoting 10–12 week lead time for replacements, RMAs take ~2 weeks transit for cross-ship. They also proposed charging shipping ($4,200/unit) unless we accept a small invoice credit. Any strong objections to asking for waiver? :eyes:
marco: can you paste the exact vendor text and the PO/SKU they referenced?
alyssa: pasted vendor email snippet below:
```
Dell Field Sales (via account):
"Current lead time for A100-80GB equivalent stock: 10-12 weeks.
Return shipping/processing typically billed at $4,200 per unit. Expedited cross-ship (where available) + customs handling = additional $800 per unit.
We can consider a one-time shipping credit if Redwood commits to 5% incremental volume over next 12 months."
```
marco: ugh. that shipping line item is new. do we have any leverage from our committed purchases / reserved capacity?
procurement: I escalated to our account team. Quick summary from them: they can waive return shipping only if RMAs are staged within 48h and we accept cross-ship from their EU pool for eu-west nodes. Lead time for replacements still ~8–10 weeks if we take their allocated stock. The 5% volume commit is negotiable — they offered a smaller credit (~$3.5k/unit) if we sign a short addendum.
jordan: important: most of the affected nodes are in eu-west-1. If vendor cross-ships from US -> EU there's customs delays. Can they cross-ship from EU stock? Also we need serials + RMA # to prioritize.
alyssa: opened RMA: RMA-22341 (vendor case 8812). Vendor asked for serials — dropping them here now:
```
SN: RDW-34KJ-001
SN: RDW-34KJ-002
SN: RDW-34KJ-007
SN: RDW-34KJ-010
SN: RDW-34KJ-012
```
ops-bot: alert: cluster eu-west-1 — 6 nodes with GPU evictions. Rolling replacement job scheduled, see runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-hot-swap (impact: ~7% p95 latency uplift).
marco: proposal: 1) Ask account team to confirm EU cross-ship availability (priority). 2) Approve expedited fee ($800/unit) for up to 8 critical GPUs if vendor can cross-ship from EU to avoid customs. 3) Keep remainder on standard backorder. Approve cost charge to INFRA-OPS emergency fund? :thinking_face:
procurement: :thumbsup: Approved up to $6,400 (covers expedited for up to 8 units). Tag invoices to cost center INFRA-OPS-3 and cc procurement@redwood.com. Also pushing for the smaller addendum credit — will update by EOD.
alyssa: thanks — I'll confirm EU stock with account team now and send serials + RMA-22341. Posting vendor response when I get it. :white_check_mark:
